title.narrative: Ubukerarugendo Imbere Project(Improved market oriented skills of the youth in the tourism and hospitality sector in Rwanda).

description.narrative: The overall objective is to improve market-oriented skills for the youth in the Tourism and Hospitality sector in Rwanda. This programme is built on 5 pillars, covering institutional and managerial capacity of TVET providers in the T&H (1), quality and relevance of TVET provision in the T&H(2), development and promotion of industrial based training(3) , the recognition of the prior learning and experience in the T&H sector (4) and professional and business support to T&H graduates in Rwanda(5).
